authority: Author/Expert GO 2026-11-16: (1) demand band option (a): fix all loads at demand; (2) IPOPT tol 1e-5, compl_inf_tol 1e-6, MA97, recovery tier off, one attempt per run; (3) a second solve per day warm-started from the coordinated solution; the default-start solve is the primary result
Author reopened the numbers freeze for these values only
budget: expected well under 1 h; launch by 2026-11-17

comparator.quantity: per day, sum over the TSO and three DSO blocks of unweighted generation_cost + flexibility_cost_internal (EUR)

failure_policy: every day reported, including failures; no re-run, no tuning, no other settings

guards.SolveProfileGuard: permitted call site p515_s55_central_check.py:_solve_one; exactly 8 solves and 8 executions (0 if refused before any solve)
guards.pickle: allow-list: exactly one load of the pinned certified_models.pkl

interpretation_declared_before_launch.C_primary < C_coord - 3 bars: the centralised solve found a cheaper operating point; reported with the warm solve, which distinguishes a coordination gap (warm also lower) from a different local optimum (warm at C_coord)
interpretation_declared_before_launch.C_primary > C_coord + 3 bars: the default start reached a worse local point; coordination not worse than the centralised solve on that day
interpretation_declared_before_launch.headline: the primary (default-start) solve is the centralised value
interpretation_declared_before_launch.|C_primary - C_coord| <= 3 bars: the same operating point within resolution

model.known_relaxation: the DN reference generators are dropped by the merge, so their P/Q limits (+/-250.001, +/-100.001, +/-250.001 MW at DN 5, 7, 9) are absent; the DN substation transformer branch ratings remain. Reported: hours where the centralised interface lies outside those limits
model.loads: every pc, qc Var fixed at load.pd / load.qd (ruling 1)
model.objective_alignment: every scalar mutable Param of the merged model set to the value carried by the coordinated certified models (refuse if they disagree); observed in the trial: penalty_gen_curtailment 1.0 -> 0.0, penalty_shared_ess_usage 0.1 -> 0.0 (the values the ADMM path sets); excluded: interface_settlement_weight (no interface in the merged model, settlement identically 0). Implements the handback clause: objective = the same cost components as the reported Q

also: pickled models aligned with the networks read (sizes, DSO demand bitwise)
no Param conflict among the coordinated models
every free Var used by an active constraint or the objective is set by the mapping
pre_solve_gates.applies_to: all four days, evaluated before the first solve; any failure refuses the run with zero solves
pre_solve_gates.trial_values_2026_11_16: mapped cost - comparator <= 9e-11 EUR; max violation 1.0e-4 to 3.2e-4 (node_balance_p / pij_def at the interface: the consensus residual)

predictions.P1: primary: IPOPT exit "Optimal Solution Found" on 4/4 days ("Solved To Acceptable Level" counts as a failure)
predictions.P2: warm: "Optimal Solution Found" and |C_warm - C_coord| <= 1e-4 x C_coord on 4/4 days
predictions.P3: same basin from the default start: |C_primary - C_warm| <= 1e-4 x C_coord on 4/4 days
predictions.P4: expectation (sign): C_warm <= C_coord + 3 bars (= 3 x bar_rel x C_coord) on 4/4 days; a failure means the warm solve left the coordinated neighbourhood for a different local point (IPOPT is not monotone from a feasible start), not a coordination defect
predictions.P5: warm: max over hours of |P_int,centralised - P_int,coordinated DSO side| <= 0.1 MW per DN, read against the coordinated TSO-DSO mismatch; a P5 failure with P2 holding reads as a flat optimum (flexibility ties across equal-price hours), not an error. No prediction on Q

reported.C: value(total_gen_cost) + value(total_flex_cost) (TN generation + DN flexibility, EUR/day)
reported.aggregate: sum over the four days of C and C_coord (unweighted)
reported.beside: total_slack_penalties and the full merged objective, against the coordinated detector terms and Q-day
per_day_and_start: termination condition and IPOPT exit text
C, C - C_coord in EUR, %, and in bars
max constraint violation after the solve
hour-by-hour interface P, Q, V per DN against the coordinated TSO and DSO sides
hours outside the dropped reference-generator limits

resolution.definition: band of the coordinated certification (4,209.17 EUR) / Q (653,873,702.19 EUR), applied per day as a fraction of C_coord -- scaled, not measured per day

solver.call: Network.run_smopf(model, params, from_warm_start=False) for both starts
solver.inherited_unchanged: every other TSO option: acceptable_tol 1e-4, acceptable_iter 5, bound_push 1e-6, bound_frac 1e-6, slack_bound_push 1e-6, slack_bound_frac 1e-6, file_print_level 6, output_file; production pins fixed_variable_treatment and max_iter 500

stage: P5.15 S55 centralised single-day check, Step 2 (frozen spec v1)

starts.primary: the model's own initial values (production initialisers); THE centralised result
starts.warm: a separately built merged model whose free primal Vars are set from the coordinated certified models of that day (eval d110bd1a, certified_models.pkl sha256 99ab1070..., one guarded load); DN e, f rotated by the coordinated TSO voltage angle at the interface bus (each DSO model measures angles from its own reference bus); no duals; same options
